newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso closes 6.3 up on thin dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso closes 6.3 up on thin dollar demand.

text.p: Colombia's peso rose for the third consecutive day closing 6.3 pesos up at 1,009.7 to the dollar, interbank traders said.

The central bank went on red alert when the peso climbed 7.7 pesos to 1,009 -- the intraday high -- at midsession. The leap placed it just 21 centavos beneath the ceiling of the daily floating rate exchange band, after which the central bank would have been obliged to intervene to prop up the dollar.
